pagerbot: :rotating_light: SEV 1 - error spike detected - route=/v1/chat.generate tenant=acme-savings 5m error-rate=78%
Sam: on it. grabbing logs and pins
Priya: quick lookup shows chat route for tenant pinned to variant `rw-instruct-2` (instruct-only) since 2026-03-14T22:10:02Z
Luca: oh no. chat->instruct chain triggers fallback to gen-compat which returns incompatible payloads -> schema validation fails at gateway -> 500s
Sam: that matches the traces. examples in logs look like instruct-style responses coming back for chat streaming. customers see truncated messages and errors.
Nora: CSM reports a production outage for a subset of users; front-end retry logic hit loops. customer impact: roughly 12% of requests for that tenant failed during window, approx 11:42-11:58 UTC
Priya: mitigation idea: insert per-tenant routing override to bypass pinned variant, disable instruct-type fallbacks for chat routes, and roll back the pin via API
Sam: applying override now (temp).
deploy-bot: POST /internal/overrides apply tenant=acme-savings scope=route:chat -> status=200 id=ovr-203
Sam: override in place. forcing chat->fallback to nearest chat-capable variant. watching metrics.
Luca: errors dropping immediately. p95 latency steady. good signal.
Nora: noted for post-incident: rollout of `rw-instruct-2` was labelled `instruct-only` but console allowed pin to any route. need validation.
Priya: taking action items: (1) add server-side pin validation (prevent cross-protocol pin), (2) add UI warning on console when selecting variant mismatched to route type, (3) add a metric/alert for per-tenant fallback-rates >5%
Sam: creating incident ticket INC-2026-5017 with timeline, queries, and sample request/response.
Nora: estimate customer-visible window ~16 minutes, affected sessions ~3.4k, pages escalated to CSM.
Luca: I'll own the remediation PR for the pin API validation. Priya, can you own the alert dashboard?
Priya: yep.
Sam: I'll remain on-call for 30 more minutes then hand to Luca. leaving notes: how to reproduce, affected tenant, how we mitigated (override + unpin later), and logs.
Luca: oncall ack. assigning follow-up and scheduling postmortem 24h.
Sam: thanks team. adding timeline to INC-2026-5017 and flagging product + eng-runtime for fix.
pagerbot: Incident acknowledged by Luca. :white_check_mark:
